record.field: # MO - Link: Find and link existing Manufacturing Orders to this Sales Order # This action searches for MOs where the Source/Origin field matches the SO name # The compute method will automatically include them in the smart button # Check if MRP module is installed try: mrp_production = env['mrp.production'] except KeyError: raise UserError("Manufacturing (MRP) module is not installed. Please install it first.") # Find MOs where origin (Source field) matches this SO's name matching_mos = mrp_production.search([ ('origin', '=', record.name), ('state', '!=', 'cancel') ]) if not matching_mos: action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': 'No MOs Found', 'message': f"No Manufacturing Orders found with Source = '{record.name}'.\n\nTo link MOs, first set the Source field in the MO (Miscellaneous tab) to match this SO number.", 'type': 'warning', 'sticky': True, } } else: # Trigger recomputation of mrp_production_ids # The overridden _compute_mrp_production_ids will pick up MOs with matching origin record._compute_mrp_production_ids() # Add chatter messages for audit trail mo_names = [] for mo in matching_mos: mo_names.append(mo.name) # Add chatter link in MO so_link = f"{record.name}" mo.message_post(body=f"Linked to Sales Order {so_link}") # Add chatter in Sales Order mo_links = ', '.join([f"{mo.name}" for mo in matching_mos]) record.message_post(body=f"Linked Manufacturing Orders: {mo_links}") action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': 'MOs Linked Successfully', 'message': f"Successfully linked {len(matching_mos)} Manufacturing Order(s):\n" + "\n".join(mo_names), 'type': 'success', 'sticky': False, } }

# MO - Unlink: Remove link between SO and MOs by clearing the origin field # This removes MOs from the smart button without deleting them # Check if MRP module is installed try: mrp_production = env['mrp.production'] except KeyError: raise UserError("Manufacturing (MRP) module is not installed.") # Get MOs linked via origin field linked_mos = mrp_production.search([ ('origin', '=', record.name), ('state', '!=', 'cancel') ]) if not linked_mos: action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': 'No Linked MOs', 'message': f"No Manufacturing Orders are linked to this Sales Order via the Source field.", 'type': 'info', 'sticky': False, } } else: # Clear origin field to remove the link mo_names = [] for mo in linked_mos: mo_names.append(mo.name) mo.write({'origin': False}) # Add chatter message in MO so_link = f"{record.name}" mo.message_post(body=f"Unlinked from Sales Order {so_link}") # Trigger recomputation to update smart button record._compute_mrp_production_ids() # Log in Sales Order mo_links = ', '.join([f"{mo.name}" for mo in linked_mos]) record.message_post(body=f"Unlinked {len(linked_mos)} Manufacturing Order(s): {mo_links}") # Show notification action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': { 'title': 'MOs Unlinked', 'message': f"Successfully unlinked {len(linked_mos)} Manufacturing Order(s):\n" + "\n".join(mo_names), 'type': 'success', 'sticky': False, } }
